title: 04 T1S_IRQ_L pull-up R508 moved from mid-board to the MCU's ball B3
why: R508 stood 25 mm from U401 and 28 mm from U501, 14 mm south of the straight line between them, under the GND busbar: a detour or a stub with a via. Ball B3 is in the second row from U401's south edge and leaves on B.Cu.
